reason: The coil and insulated tank seem like the core of a heat store, so I want to assemble them first.
expectation: I expect a tank fitted with a coil to transfer heat into stored water; it may still need connecting to the processor.

alternatives.reason: This looks like the screen, but I am more curious about the heat store first.

effect: The coil and tank made the store; it still needs water and likely a connection to the processor.
reason: Fill the store so it has water to hold heat.
expectation: The tank will be filled and ready to connect or heat.

effect: The filled store can now connect to the processor exchanger.
reaction: This follows naturally from filling the tank.
reason: Connect the store to the heat source to capture the processor's waste heat.
expectation: The water will warm through the exchanger and store heat for later.

effect: The stored heat serves the root zone after the processor stops; the heat goal is complete.
reaction: I like seeing where the recovered heat will actually help.
reason: This is the only available combination and seems like the frame and covering for the remaining screen goal.
expectation: A framed reflective screen will be made, perhaps needing installation at the bench.

effect: The quilt and frame made an insulated inner screen, ready to fit at the bench.
reaction: That is consistent with the materials, though I do not yet know how it adjusts.
reason: Fit the screen to the bench to complete the remaining goal; this is the only combination offered.
expectation: The bench gains an adjustable insulated screen.

effect: The screen makes an insulated growing nook and completes the chapter, though its adjustment mechanism remains unspecified.
reaction: I like the resulting cozy space, but wanted a clearer picture of how the screen moves.

mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the filled store to the processor made the waste heat useful for the root zone after shutdown. The concrete link between a process and a later need was satisfying.

leastWorthwhile.text: Filling the store was predictable and had little descriptive payoff on its own.

surprise.text: I had not expected the stored warmth to be specifically for the root zone until the result said so.

arbitrary.text: The screen assembly had a clear purpose, but the result did not show how it adjusts around the bench.

continue.text: Yes, I would continue to see how the station and its discoveries develop; this chapter's practical reuse of heat was appealing, though the choices themselves were mostly straightforward.
